## Weekly Update - 2026-09-20

Hey <@&1424461167883194418> — 109 PRs merged. The garden has been extremely productive.

🤖 **Agents grew some memory**
- New agent usage Quests, switchable agent/MCP KPIs, and clearer input/output modality declarations.
- Computer MCP gained collective memory, caller-authored GitHub commits, plus `xan`, `html-to-markdown`, and file tools.
- New prompt agents include CatGPT, Sirius Elevator, and Barnaby the Crow, who remembers things so you don’t have to pretend you do.

🌻 **Models became easier to inspect**
- Dashboard now shows healthy models by default; `/v1/models` and `/models` include model health.
- Catalogs can filter by source and reliability; per-route health is available at `/models/status`.
- Added `gpt-4o-mini`, `hy4-preview`, `hy3`, `flux.2-max`, ElevenLabs Music v2.5, and more. `gpt-image-2.5` now routes through Azure with OpenAI fallback.

🛠️ **Developer surfaces, less ceremonial**
- `polli update` updates global CLI installs; CLI usage can filter by key, model, and day range.
- Inline media sharing and copyable code blocks landed, alongside better auth/error handling and refreshed API docs.

🌱 **Community catalog kept blooming**
- New apps across image, build, chat, writing, learn, and video/audio — including Pollen Craft, GitMuse, SQLCraft, Oracle Mystique, and PersonaMorph.

Docs: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations • API reference: https://text.pollinations.ai/openapi
